matched_queries: Discover UK employment guidance for Seafarers Charter. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
Guidance to assist harbour authorities and service operators comply with the Seafarers (Wages and Working Conditions) Act 2023, the Seafarers’ Wages Regulations 2024 and Seafarers (Wages and Working Conditions) Regulations 2026.

The guidance provides practical advice and examples explaining:

the duties on harbour authorities

providing national minimum wage equivalence declarations, or remuneration and safe working declarations

surcharges for failing to provide a declaration

the refusal of access to ports for failure to pay a surcharge

calculating pay

the rules on maximum periods onboard vessels
